Dear João,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
After checking all the information, you shared with us, we could check on the charger, and I confirm that you have the maximum power delivery settled at 140kW.

additional_info.body:

Unfortunately, the settings being sent to the charger are not working.
Yesterday, a BYD Seal charger, capable of charging up to 150kW, recharged Décio's charger, but the station only delivered 33kW (because a BYD Dolphin charger was also on connector 2). When the BYD Dolphin finished charging, minutes later the station started delivering only 60kW to the Seal.
Best Regards,
